lewis.source: Lewis 2011 author manuscript, Table VII, PDF p44; reads/production.md
lewis.transport: Counted Mexico-born contribution to the nationwide D/HS-equivalent ratio; proportional incidence and exposed-sector share are assumed, not identified.

peri.source: Peri 2012 published paper, Table 2, p352; reads/production.md
peri.transport: Treat counted current Mexico-born earners as a historical immigrant-worker inflow, applying the mixed-skill state coefficient nationally. Diagnostic only.

putterman_weil.source: Putterman-Weil October2009 revision, Table4 p34; reads/social_institutions.md
putterman_weil.transport: Assign 2000 Mexico ancestry-statehist to every 2024 lineage member and the 2000 US index to the observed whole-US mixture; all country-level covariance acts as a uniform native externality. These are unverified assumptions.

briggeman.source: Briggeman 2022 Table3 p92, population-weighted geographic-controls specification; reads/social_institutions.md
briggeman.transport: Same ecological plug-in as Putterman-Weil, using an alternative observational specification.

clemens_pritchett.source: Clemens-Pritchett IZA dp9730, Eq3 p18; Table1 p35; reads/social_institutions.md
clemens_pritchett.transport: Threshold and derivative in the authors' model only. The 2024 lineage's unassimilated dynastic labor buffer phi is not measured.

politics.source: Mayda-Peri-Steingress 2022 author proof II p6 (adults18+, low skill belowHS, high skill HS+) and Table5 p19; appendix TableA3 p45; Funke-Schularick-Trebesch AER2023 pp3269-3273; reads/politics_other_channels.md
politics.transport: Vote arithmetic is a stock-dose extrapolation, not a government-probability estimate. Funke's 0.10 is an approximate year15 graph, not a transport confidence bound.

attention.transport: Reuse of gross spending under incompatible attribution conventions; not net lost GDP, not a causal low-skill share response.
